author: GameTrailers
description: Built as a new permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, World of Warcraft: Forever invites past, current, and new players into a familiar yet fresh Azeroth where the world takes center stage, community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination. Set after the events of Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom and before Molten Core, players will return to the original continents, adventure to level 60, and continue progressing through new stories, experiences, and updates inspired by years of player passion and feedback. World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, with beta beginning Thursday, September 17.
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official New Horizons Cinematic Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Return to the Last Days of Lordaeron to experience the fall of one great city and play a part in the founding of another. Test your strategic mettle and meet heroes familiar and new across over 30 hours of new campaign content. Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom launches today.
title: Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: For the first time in more than two decades, a new campaign has arrived in Warcraft III: Reforged. Forsaken Kingdom follows the fall of Lordaeron and its transformation into becoming the Undercity, introducing new faces alongside familiar figures, like Sylvanas, as players discover what it truly means to be Forsaken.
title: Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Launch Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The Last Titan is more than a return to Northrend—it’s a reflection on generations of courage, sacrifice, and unforgettable deeds across Azeroth. From the Shifting Sands of Ahn’Qiraj to the Frozen Throne, the Worldbreaker, the Burning Legion, and even the realms beyond life and death, heroes have fought time and again to defend our home. As Azeroth calls on us one last time, this next chapter will offer a glimpse at the challenges waiting ahead when more is revealed early next year, after the events of Midnight: Eclipse.
title: World of Warcraft - Official The Last Titan Teaser Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The next major content update for Midnight, Eclipse, brings players face-to-face with Xal’atath as she hovers just within reach of her ultimate objective: the Worldsoul. With Azeroth’s fate hanging in the balance, players will need to confront her directly and stop her from claiming victory. The events of Eclipse will unfold in the worldcore, setting the stage for a revelation and conflict that will carry the Worldsoul Saga toward its final chapter in The Last Titan.
title: World of Warcraft Midnight: Eclipse - Official Reveal Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
If Doomfist plans to make a new gauntlet, he’s going to need help from a very old friend.

Join him and his allies as they work to break out Doctrine from the depths of Watchpoint: Grimsvotn in our newest Hero Trailer, ‘Breakout.’

And after, play as our newest Support Hero, Doctrine, during his limited time Hero Trial Sep 12-14 before his official release with the launch of Season 5.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, now including Nintendo Switch™ 2"!
title: Overwatch - Official New Hero Doctrine Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Harness the powers of the Void and devastate your enemies with a new Ranged Assassin: Xal'atath. 

Xal'atath Pre-purchase to get limited-time Heartseeker Xal’atath Skin​
title: Heroes of the Storm - Official Xal'atath Reveal Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Discover the secrets of Azeroth’s newest playable race, harness powers yet unseen, and take new first steps through lands untrodden when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026. Or, uncover Azeroth’s mysteries early by playing in the WoW: Forever Beta starting September 17, 2026, when you pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection.
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Transformers Add-On Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creation adventure game developed by Mojang. Players will be able to morph into one of 12 characters, including Optimus Prime and Megatron, each with unique abilities, weapons, and vehicles. Take on players in three different battle modes, like Deathmatch or Last Man Standing. The Transformers Add-On is available now on Minecraft.
title: Minecraft - Official Transformers Add-On Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Heavy Bowgun Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Heavy Bowgun and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring the Boosted Compression Cannon, loading & firing overcharged rounds, and reduced recoil. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Heavy Bowgun Boosted Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Teaser Trailer for FleetRush, a 2D real-time strategy game developed by Grigory Shcherbakov. Players will command the flow of battle across air, land, and sea to secure victory at all costs. Take on bosses, destroy enemy bases, and access new ships along the way. FleetRush is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#FleetRush #Gaming #IGN
title: FleetRush - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Story Trailer for Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon, a first-person open-world action RPG developed by Questline. Players will fight through an unforgiving world influenced by iconic Arthurian legends. Celebrate the game's sales milestone with Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Official Gameplay Story Trailer
